core_obligations: Identify (V x_y X)' with the localization of the site at (f')^{-1}h_y (Sites localization lemma) so pr' is the localization morphism and (pr')^{-1} preserves injectives (proof lines 3331-3363).
Pushforward formula: f'_*H(y) = Gamma((V x_y X)', (pr')^{-1}H) from the cited equation (proof lines 3338-3344).

Injective resolution: (pr')^{-1} exact and injective-preserving makes (pr')^{-1}I^bullet an injective resolution of (pr')^{-1}H, and the Gamma complex computes R^p f'_* (proof lines 366-386 of the span, i.e. lines 3366-3386).
proof_roadmap: Recognize the fibre-product site as a localization.
Compute R^p f'_* from the pulled-back injective resolution.
difficulty_reason: The fibre product site (V x_y X)' is identified with the localization of X_lisse-etale at the sheaf of sets (f')^{-1}h_y (cited localization lemma), so pr' is a localization morphism whose inverse image preserves injectives; an injective resolution then computes R^p f'_* pointwise as the cohomology of the Gamma complex of the pulled-back resolution, which is an injective resolution of the pullback.
